title: Lamp-saint
about: One more origin: a person whose head is a lamp.

origins.name: Lamp-saint
origins.trait: Your head is a lamp. You can shine or go dark.

novice.name: Lantern beam
novice.desc: To hit {WISATK}, range 40 ft. Damage 1d8 radiant.

utility.name: Warm light
utility.desc: Once a fight, one friend you can see heals 1d6.

expert.name: Blinding flash
expert.desc: Once a fight, creatures next to you can't see you until your next turn.

crit.name: Sunspot
crit.desc: On a crit, the target can't hide until your next turn.
